headline: Leafs’ Rielly out day-to-day; Sissons out week-to-week
take:
Daily Faceoff reports Morgan Rielly is day-to-day with a lower-body injury after missing one game, and Colin Sissons is out week-to-week after getting hurt Sunday. Rielly is the one that matters, and the timing is bad.

Toronto is 8-9-2, and our numbers say that record flatters them. The Leafs have taken 47% of the expected goals (the quality of chances), 46% at five on five, which means they're being outplayed most nights. What has kept them near .500 is finishing: they've scored 6.5 more goals than their chances deserve. That cushion usually shrinks. Losing a top defenseman, even for a few games, asks a team that's already leaning on hot shooting to get even more of it. We'd watch the shot share in the games he misses more than the scores.
